Any devx seat may claim it. `domain:devx` is inherited from the parent.

## Scope
**Files:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`. No other file. ⛔ No product code.

**Rows:** 26, from the seat's read-only census of every finding parked on #27377 (census note 6539602007), taken at origin/main `501c864dd5`. Re-verify each row against the current head before editing. A row that no longer holds is reported as fixed upstream.

- main's `history` stays an exact prefix, with ONE appended row citing the run record (#27392, #27409, #27438, #27441 or #27481) and #27377.
- The text is fixed to what the code says today.
- An edit may make a clause stronger or more precise. It never weakens a clause to make it pass.
- A finding that, on reading, is a product defect is NOT edited. It is reported for the seat to file.
- Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green.
- Changeset: none (label `skip-changeset`).
- The PR says `Fixes #<this card>` and `Part of #27377`.
